name: sim_riemannian_torch_foundation
description: Torch-native Riemannian geometry foundation: metric tensor g_ij, inner product, Christoffel symbols via autograd, geodesic evolution, Gaussian curvature — all torch float64. Migration batch 4 of geometry families.

pytorch.reason: Riemannian metric g_ij as 2×2 torch float64 tensor, inner product ⟨u,v⟩_g via quadratic form, Christoffel computation via autograd of metric, geodesic evolution step

pyg.reason: Graph structure not needed for local Riemannian geometry

z3.reason: UNSAT: det(g) ≤ 0 ∧ g positive definite is impossible (pos-def requires det > 0); metric signature constraint

cvc5.reason: z3 real arithmetic solver sufficient for metric determinant/eigenvalue constraints

sympy.reason: Symbolic Christoffel symbol formula Γ^k_ij = ½g^{kl}(∂_i g_jl + ∂_j g_il - ∂_l g_ij) and Riemann tensor index algebra verification

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed for Riemannian metric foundation

geomstats.reason: Geomstats backend not required for metric tensor foundation sim

e3nn.reason: Equivariant networks not needed for basic Riemannian structure

rustworkx.reason: Graph algorithms not applicable to continuous Riemannian geometry

xgi.reason: Hypergraph structure not needed for metric tensor

toponetx.reason: Topological complexes not required for Riemannian foundation

gudhi.reason: Persistent homology not needed for metric curvature foundation

P1_euclidean_positive_definite.description: Euclidean metric I is positive definite

P4_flat_metric_vanishing_christoffels.description: Christoffel symbols vanish for flat (Euclidean) metric (by Riemannian theory)

P6_autograd_metric.description: Metric tensor is differentiable via pytorch autograd

P7_sympy_christoffel_formula.description: sympy: Christoffel symbol formula verified symbolically

P8_positive_eigenvalues.description: Positive definite metric has all positive eigenvalues

N1_z3_metric_pos_def_unsat.description: z3 UNSAT: det(g) ≤ 0 ∧ positive definite contradictory

B1_metric_scaling.description: Scaling metric scales determinant: det(cg) = c² det(g)

B2_geodesic_flat_constant_velocity.description: Geodesic on flat metric has approximately constant velocity

B3_curvature_continuity.description: Gaussian curvature varies continuously with metric perturbations
